title: Travis Lenkner featured in Legal Business Magazine on law firm equity
summary: Legal Business reports that Burford Capital’s Chief Development Officer, Travis Lenkner, sees external investment playing an increasingly important role in the legal sector—while stressing that Burford’s model is distinct from traditional private equity. The piece highlights rising interest from top-tier firms and the growing recognition that equity investment is becoming a key part of the profession’s future. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*Legal Business* reports that Burford Capital’s Chief Development Officer,[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) , sees external investment playing an increasingly important role in the legal sector—while stressing that Burford’s model is distinct from traditional private equity. The piece highlights rising interest from top-tier firms and the growing recognition that equity investment is becoming a key part of the profession’s future.


Read the full article[here](https://www.legalbusiness.co.uk/law-firms/were-not-private-equity-burford-capital-cdo-travis-lenker-on-the-future-of-private-investment-in-law-firms/) .
